summary_en: Shin Nippon Air Technologies authorized acquisition of up to 1 million shares (2.19% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 3.5 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 13, 2026 and March 31, 2027, to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency while maintaining progressive dividends with a DOE floor of 5%.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Shin Nippon Air Technologies' Board of Directors resolved on November 12, 2026 to acquire up to 1 million shares of its own common stock, representing 2.19% of outstanding shares (45,571,318 shares as of October 31, 2026), for a maximum total consideration of 3.5 billion yen. The acquisition will be conducted through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 13, 2026 and March 31, 2027.

The company positions shareholder returns as a key management priority. The acquisition is undertaken in accordance with the capital allocation policy that sets a DOE (dividend on equity) floor of 5% and commits to progressive dividends through fiscal 2029. The board determined that the buyback will enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency alongside the dividend program.
